items.html: And behold, corresponding to them there are also three phases in Zeir Anpin and Nukva: the first is the lights of the vessels that were divided at the time of the breaking of the vessels, that descended below into Beria, and then ascended above, as mentioned. The second is the phase of the vessels that broke and descended below into Beria. The third is the phase of the 288 sparks called the breath of the bones, which are the sparks of light that remained within the broken vessels to give them life, as mentioned.
